build: lean muscled, the kind that comes from standing all day at a worktable
hair: dark brown, almost black, shoulder-length with a slight wave she doesn't fight; often pinned back with whatever's near—a pencil, a silk scarf, a wooden stick
complexion: warm ivory with a golden undertone; a small scar along her left jawline from a kiln accident at nineteen that she stopped covering up
face: a face that broadcasts feeling—wide-set eyes that go soft when she's concentrating, a mouth quick to smile or tremble, the kind of face that makes strangers trust her too fast
signature_feature: her hands—long-fingered, calloused at the knuckles and fingertips, stained permanently with clay dust in the creases; he watches them move when she talks
second_celebrated_feature: the slope of her neck into her shoulder, exposed when she pulls her hair up; a vulnerability he can't stop noticing
signature_habits: she tastes everything she makes—clay dust on her fingers, the salt of her own sweat, the mineral smell of slip; she hums while working, mostly old Korean lullabies her grandmother taught her (오빠생각, oppa saenggak); she sleeps with her hands clenched into fists; she apologizes reflexively, even when it's not her fault
occupation: ceramic artist and studio owner—a small independent pottery studio in a converted warehouse, three employees, custom commissions and teaching classes; financially precarious but hers

current_crisis.event: her landlord—a development company owned by a billionaire's holding firm—has given her ninety days' notice; the warehouse is being demolished for luxury condos; she has no capital to relocate, no backup studio, and three employees depending on her
current_crisis.hottest_emotion: panic threaded with a deeper shame—that she's failed, that she's not enough, that wanting something this badly makes her pathetic
current_crisis.immediate_want: to find a way to save the studio without losing her dignity or admitting she's drowning

wound.core: she believes that needing people is weakness; that if she loves something too openly, it will be taken
wound.surfacing_hint: when she's frightened, she goes very still and quiet, her eyes going distant; she stops asking for help and starts planning how to do everything alone, even the impossible
